p: mouth: God encourages the Prophet to signify the speedy coming of the enemy against Israel, which was once the people of God.
cry unto me: They will cry like hypocrites, but not from the heart, as their deeds declare.
kings: That is, Jeroboam, by whom they sought their own liberty, and to obey my will.
innocency: That is, upright judgment and a godly life.
For from Israel was it also: Meaning the calf was invented by themselves, and by their fathers in the wilderness.
sown the wind: Showing that their religion has but a show, and in itself is but vanity.
wild ass alone by himself: They never cease, but run to and fro to seek help.
burden of the king of princes: That is, for the king and the princes will lay upon them: and by this means the Lord brings them to repentance.
strange thing: In this way the idolaters consider the word of God as strange with regard to their own invention.
LORD accepteth them not: Saying that they offer it to the Lord, but he accepts no service which he himself has not appointed.
